title: onboarding pairing registration
objective: Wire onboarding to register WebID<->Stellar pairing using existing NodeZeroIdentity contract and persist attestation inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: On authenticated onboarding, register_webid is invoked for active wallet/webId pair.
Attestation inputs are persisted for later verification.
Failure path surfaces actionable user messaging.

title: chain reads for pairing verification
objective: Provide client read paths for get_webid and get_state_root using existing contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: No new contract deployment requirement introduced.

title: returning sign-in attestation verification
objective: Implement and validate returning sign-in pairing verification flow against lockb0x-root-backed attestation proof inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Returning sign-in validates mapping + root-backed attestation state.
Mismatch path fails closed and prompts relink/re-attest.
Validation evidence is posted to inbox with reproducible steps.

title: attestation staging validation
objective: Execute attestation-focused smoke/UAT matrix and produce release evidence for onboarding and returning-sign-in pairing checks.
acceptanceCriteria: UAT includes register_webid tx evidence and lockbox root-read verification.
Pass/fail matrix for attestation states is posted to inbox.
Release recommendation (GO/BLOCK) is updated with rationale.

title: attestation evidence docs update
objective: Publish attestation-focused release evidence and remove remaining PoH drift from docs/wiki after QA results.
acceptanceCriteria: Linked evidence paths added for QA validation outcomes.
